provenance.note: Measurements precede storage-boundary merge; resilience binary precedes final outbox ownership and authoritative paging refinements. Final merged-source verification is recorded separately.

limitations: Single developer machine; not production capacity claims.
Synthetic reporter describes 10000 groups with one index each outside authoritative table placement. Three actual data nodes serve concurrent DDL.
Snapshot transfers are single cold captures, not steady-state latency samples.
Telemetry comparison uses two request modes on the same binary, not two different release binaries.
Sparse publication excludes lazy flat-array materialization; first-reader cost is reported separately.
Outbox limits bound logical sample payload; allocator and coalescing map overhead is additional.
